decisions.reason: As a simple track-system accessory that builds directly on the firm's installed base, it is cheap to keep as an option and likely still supports the core premium lighting business unless clear negative market feedback has emerged.
This LED luminaire is close to the core range and therefore worth keeping unless sales have clearly disappointed, although single luminaires face some model-refresh risk after several years.

A home automation server box is more support-intensive and technologically uncertain than the firm's core luminaires, so after several years the option value is likely lower than the benefit of reallocating resources if adoption has not clearly taken off.

A luminaire family shown on its own page suggests a more substantial commitment in a core category, and in a growing market it is relatively attractive to retain unless results have clearly revealed weak demand.
